verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships an AI SRE agent, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, every MCP mention in the evidence describes Better Stack acting as an MCP server that exposes its telemetry to external LLM clients such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop. Nothing shows users plugging third-party MCP servers into Better Stack or its AI SRE so it can call their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
